1. What the daemon tells the prime and PA: PA missing or dormant and over-600k (217), compaction wake (222), idle nudge (224: never a cold wake, the prime gets an FYI, PIJ_IDLE_NUDGE=1 in the fleet), dialog stall (219). Each row says who gets it and what to do.
2. Stall checks via --limit, else default_limit: a check-in, then an escalation to the PA (else the prime). Recommended for merger-like roles.

4. 600k means compact at it; never revive a large seat, spawn fresh on its handover; record the model per role. One correction to the brief: pij doesn't apply default_seat.model at spawn (nothing reads it), so the route says to pass it when spawning.
5. Close, then tmux kill-pane, until #200.
6. C33 in one line.
